approval_source.question_set: E05 values, second set: validators, recovery, upgrades, issuance, fees and bootstrap

decisions.question: D09-Q01
decisions.selected: 16 active, bounds 4 to 32; 100,000 DGT self-bond, bounds 10,000 to 1,000,000 DGT
decisions.note: Self-bond values are uDGT. The genesis builder sets reward_v2.max_validators to at least 32.

decisions.question: D11-Q03
decisions.note: Carried by the production upgrade policy (schema 2), which is not implemented yet.

decisions.question: D01-Q01
decisions.selected: 1,000 DRT per block; 0.5x to 1x with base as the ceiling; 50% utilization target
decisions.note: Per 17,280-block epoch: base and ceiling 1,000 DRT a block (about 6.31 billion DRT a year), floor 500 DRT a block. Launch issuance equals the base, so the first epoch's command equals it. Gains, integral limits, the sample window and the shock threshold remain open.

decisions.question: D04-Q01
decisions.selected: 1 DRT per basic transfer, governed between 0.1 and 10 DRT; account creation 10 times a transfer
decisions.note: The transfer fee is a target, not a field. Engineering derives the gas price, per-resource costs and their bounds from the metering so a basic transfer costs 1 DRT and governance can move it only between 0.1 and 10 DRT, and returns them for confirmation.
